channel: EARLY RESEARCH footage 2014-2022: VGAN, TGAN, MoCoGAN, DVD-GAN, TATS, VideoGPT, NUWA, CogVideo (2022), Video Diffusion Models, Make-A-Video, Imagen Video, Phenaki, and pre-2022 GAN/VAE video synthesis
method: Commons API (about 75 full-text queries + 22 category walks), arXiv abs pages for licence links (about 640 video-generation papers 2016-2022 scanned via export.arxiv.org API; only CC BY / CC BY-SA hits kept), arXiv e-print source tarballs and PDFs for CC BY papers, blobless git clones of 21 GitHub repos (LICENSE + tree + commit history) with raw.githubusercontent.com downloads probed with ffprobe/PIL/numpy in the Higgsfield sandbox, official project pages, Internet Archive advancedsearch + metadata API, Wikipedia raw wikitext. NO frame was viewed by me: every content statement comes from page text, LaTeX captions, ffprobe/PIL numbers or simple pixel statistics (marked 'measured'). Higgsfield video_analysis was not possible (media_import_url rejects raw.githubusercontent.com mp4: 'Unsupported content-type: application/octet-stream'). Repo-level code licences are NOT treated as automatic media permission: every repo-hosted clip is 'likely', never 'clear'. HEADLINE RESULT: none of the twelve named projects has clearly licensed original footage on an official page; the legitimately reusable material is (a) CogVideo's own sample mp4 and frame-strip PNGs inside its Apache-2.0 repo history, (b) MIT-licensed demo GIFs of TGAN, TGANv2, TATS and (Snap) MoCoGAN-HD, (c) four CC BY-SA 4.0 DCGAN GIFs on Commons, (d) CC BY 4.0 arXiv figures (frame strips) of TATS, VideoGPT, StyleGAN-V, and (e) one Internet Archive StyleGAN clip with a PD-mark and stated basis. Make-A-Video, Imagen Video, Phenaki, Video Diffusion Models, NUWA, DVD-GAN, VGAN and MoCoGAN (2017) have no reusable footage and must be represented by original, labelled RECONSTRUCTION / ILLUSTRATION graphics (see project_verdicts).

candidates.description: Page text says only 'DCGAN Anime 128*128 trained on 63k images'. rejected.reason: VGAN (2016) GIFs: 80 files hosted on the author's site (now https://www.cs.columbia.edu/~vondrick/tinyvideo/). No licence text on the page; arXiv licence is the non-exclusive one; the GitHub README declares 'License MIT' for the code but the GIFs are hotlinked, not in the repo. UNCLEAR-to-NO. Missing evidence: a licence statement or written permission from Carl Vondrick (MIT/Columbia). Page notes that its training videos come from the Yahoo Flickr Creative Commons dataset and Flickr tag queries.
Code repository only; README 'License MIT' with no LICENSE file; no media in tree.

MoCoGAN (2017): 7 doc GIFs (faces, action, taichi, shapes...) but the repo has NO LICENSE file and no licence statement; outputs are trained on MUG facial expressions and human-action data (real-person risk). NO.
NUWA (2021-11-24): assets/NUWA.gif, nuwa/t2v.gif etc. in tree, but the repo has no LICENSE (only SECURITY.md) and arXiv licence is non-exclusive: all rights reserved by default. NO.
DVD-GAN (2019-07-15): only paper figures (arXiv non-exclusive licence) and Google Drive links for 'Full samples'; no code or licence; NO.
Video Diffusion Models (2022-04-07): about 30 animated WebP samples (assets/000.webp ..., fireworks_q80.webp) on the supplementary page; no licence text; paper arXiv non-exclusive; NO.
Imagen Video (2022-10-05): 11 mp4 samples on the official page; no licence text; page states 'We have decided not to release the Imagen Video model or its source code'; paper arXiv non-exclusive; NO.

Phenaki (arXiv 2022-10-05): hero and story mp4s hosted on storage.googleapis.com; no licence text; NO. (Prompts on the page are useful as text for a labelled reconstruction.) The old phenaki.video host returned no response.
Make-A-Video (Meta announcement 2022-09-29): GIF gallery and prompt list; page footer only 'Meta (c) 2023' with Privacy/Terms links; no reuse permission; blog page also without media licence; NO.

VideoGPT project-page mp4s (bair_1frame_cond, ucf_128_uncond, ucf_class_cond, tgif_uncond, hgs, hgs_action_cond, battle2, battle2_action_cond; page says 'Non-cherry picked samples are shown below'). Files live in github.com/wilson1yan/wilson1yan.github.io which has no LICENSE. UNCLEAR. Missing: an explicit statement or e-mail permission from Wilson Yan; paper (CC BY 4.0) and MIT code repo do not extend to these files. Use the CC BY paper figures instead.

TATS project-page videos (overview and many long-video mp4s under results/ and www.cs.umd.edu/~songweig/tats/): no licence on the page and the site repo was not accessible. UNCLEAR. Missing: licence statement or permission from Songwei Ge. The two MIT-licensed README GIFs are candidates instead.
StyleGAN-V repo: README says it is 'likely restricted by the NVidia license'; README GIFs are user-images attachments, not in the tree. NO for the repo media (the CC BY paper figure is a candidate).

Current HEAD videos (resources/videos/1-4.mp4, gradio_composite_demo/example_videos) are CogVideoX-era VAE/input clips of unknown provenance and the 2024 CogVideoX gallery is an attachment outside the licensed tree; not the 2022 model. The 2022 sample mp4/PNGs (in candidates) are only reachable via the old commit permalinks.

Deep Dream (2015-era technique) video experiment uploaded 2022-07-31 by jack northrup with PD Mark 1.0 but NO stated basis (description 'Deep Dream video Experiment'); UNCLEAR. Missing: statement of authorship and why it is public domain; DeepDream footage is H4's scope anyway.
AI-generated music video for a Pink Floyd recording (CC0 tag by uploader 2022-09-21): music copyright/brand IP; the CC0 dedication cannot cover the third-party song or the band's identity. NO.
VQGAN+CLIP test clips (2022-06) with no licence field; NO.
vid2vid (2018) imgs/*.gif under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LICENSE.txt: 'Licensed under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license'); NC/SA excluded by the brief; NO.

First Order Motion Model (2019/2020; repo MIT, paper arXiv:2003.00196 CC BY 4.0) but sup-mat GIFs show real people (VoxCeleb, fashion models) and cartoon (mgif) IP; excluded by the real-person / brand-IP rules. Not evaluated further.
DIGAN (2022-02): figures/sky.gif, taichi.gif in tree but the repo has no LICENSE file; NO.
Tune-A-Video (2022-12-22): repo Apache-2.0 but README result GIFs are hosted on tuneavideo.github.io (not in the licensed tree) and data/*.mp4 are real input footage; arXiv licence non-exclusive; NO.

TECO (2022-10): no LICENSE file and no media in tree. The CC BY 4.0 paper (arXiv:2210.02396) has sample figures (figures/samples/*.pdf; DMLab, Minecraft, Habitat, Kinetics) - inspected, not selected because they are game/3D-scene samples adding little variety.
MAGVIT (2022-12): Apache-2.0 code repo with no media; CC BY 4.0 paper figures (k600.png, ucf_*.png, bair_*.png) mix other authors' outputs (TATS, CCVS, RaMViD); inspected, not selected.

Generating Long Videos of Dynamic Scenes (2022-06-07) is CC BY 4.0 and would give more frame-strip stills; not extracted for time. Lead only. Same for CC BY papers 2201.06888, 2206.11894 (MaskViT), 2204.06558, 2112.10960.
Stable Diffusion 1.4 frame-by-frame animation (Oct 2022, CC BY-SA 4.0) - real, but already candidates of H2/H4; out of this channel; also cleavage-tagged categories.

MoCoGAN-HD FFHQ, FFHQ_1024, FaceForensics, UCF-101 and Sky-Time-lapse GIFs (same Snap MIT grant) not listed: face content (real-person resemblance risk) or only 6 frames / 0.6 s, and to avoid near-duplicates.

All twelve named projects' own arXiv papers except TATS and VideoGPT (and StyleGAN-V, TECO, MAGVIT) carry the arXiv non-exclusive licence: VGAN, TGAN, MoCoGAN, DVD-GAN, NUWA, Video Diffusion Models, CogVideo, Make-A-Video, Imagen Video, Phenaki. Their figures cannot be reused.
Zenodo video search returned unrelated CC BY records; no early generative-video supplements found.
